title: Core Fixture and Backend Gate Checklist

items.label: Capture the FlowDoc Work path, owner repositories, active role, Phase, Checklist, and Evidence targets before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the readiness pass under flowdoc-product-development-resumption with bounded Core and Backend evidence targets.
items.verificationNote: Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-core-backend-gate, checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-core-backend-gate, and evidence targets were identified before Project Control record edits.

items.label: Restore only the missing tracked Core PDF renderer fixture files after explicit user approval.
items.evidenceTarget: Core packages/pdf-renderer-pilot/fixtures is restored from HEAD while preserving unrelated repository state.
items.verificationNote: Before restoration, Core main had 57 tracked deletions under packages/pdf-renderer-pilot/fixtures and no other dirty status. After git restore of that path, Core git status was clean, deleted fixture count was 0, the fixture directory contained 57 files, and font-subset-manifest.v1.json existed.

items.label: Verify the Core owner gate after fixture reconciliation.
items.evidenceTarget: Core npm run check passes against commit 5892df6e542a02b25ae3b18ee02a55842b83d48f with the restored fixture working tree.
items.verificationNote: Core npm run check passed type-check and Vitest with 460 test files and 2,945 tests.

items.label: Verify the Backend PDF fixture blocker is removed before trusting the full Backend gate.
items.evidenceTarget: The previously failing Backend PDF local renderer test passes after the sibling Core fixture path is restored.
items.verificationNote: npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/tests/pdfExportLocalRenderer.test.ts passed with 1 test file and 7 tests.

items.label: Verify the Backend owner gate after Core fixture reconciliation.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend npm run check passes against commit b9615c2dcede7a2289fa75c41fca19deafdba70e with the actual sibling Core checkout.
items.verificationNote: Backend npm run check passed type-check, Vitest with 89 passed test files, 1 skipped test file, 319 passed tests, 24 skipped tests, and build.

items.label: Keep the evidence bounded and leave broad product readiness unpromoted.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence wording excludes broad Core, Backend, Editor, FlowDoc, production, deployed, frontend, persistence, and authoring readiness.
items.verificationNote: No Project Control system map or product repository behavior is promoted by this checklist. Remaining work must continue through separate Core, Backend, and Editor evidence slices.
